ablation.evaluation: TUNE ONLY; constant row budget; author-context regime contrast, not a causal population contribution

selection: C and model parameters on tune only; no train+tune refit

calibration.method: scalar temperature on log predicted probabilities, argmax preserved
calibration.selection: minimum NLL on calibration only; ties keep grid order
calibration.brier: mean sum of squared three-class probability error, range 0..2

review_policy.selection: maximum eligible policy_dev coverage, then lower risk, then fixed grid order; no feasible => REVIEW_ALL
review_policy.guarantee: NONE; small author-labeled synthetic development set

assessment: all hyperparameters, calibrators, policy thresholds and ablations saved before first assessment inference; never optimize on V2 or V3 assessment

bootstrap.unit: assessment family; paired contrasts; synthetic sensitivity only

latency.includes: vectorizer and predict_proba; policy transform overhead reported separately

v2: frozen; only TRAIN/development coverage and full text-hash denylist, no V2 re-scoring or new selection
sources: one assistant-author process; role batches and related variants remain family/component-grouped; not external/human independence

beto.reason: This phase isolates classical representation and review-policy effects. V2 encoder smoke remains valid technical evidence, not a sentiment model. Full fine-tuning resource use and human generalization are unmeasured.

human: PENDING_AUTHORIZED_KAGGLE_OR_ORIGINAL_CONSENTED_REVIEWS; V3 does not replace human validation
